title: factory-findings
description: The deterministic next-planner findings input (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC section 16; Task 10). The trusted control plane derives this payload only from orchestrator-minted findings receipts of the previous round, at the start of the next planning phase, after strict no-follow bounded parsing and binding validation (campaign id, round, phase, exact phase-base commit reachability, phase tag in the state digest ledger, and the recorded phase outcome). The payload is the only channel through which verification/audit findings and blocked references reach the next planner; it is delivered to the planner as a digest-bound prompt input and is never given to the developer, never read by the deterministic selector, and never stored as a runtime task ledger or memory.

gate_ran.description: True when the trusted orchestrator executed the explicit deterministic verification command for this phase. Task 10 review (REQ 2): the payload carries the deterministic-gate evidence so a gate-only failure (gate_ran true with a nonzero gate_exit and no structured finding) stays actionable for the next planner.

gate_exit.description: Exit status of the explicit deterministic verification command, or null when the gate did not run (audit phases).

capability_ran.description: True when the declared-capability probe ran for this phase.

capability_exit.description: Exit status of the declared-capability probe, or null when it did not run.
